name: Mikuriya Ren
source:
"Because if it's you... when I die, you'll completely forget all about me, won't you."

A second-year student who transferred into Morinomiya Academy.

Having originally worked in the entertainment industry as a child actor, she stands out incredibly well thanks to her extraordinary beauty and crisp, cheerful personality.

She used to attend a different, ordinary school, but transferred in after her "Gift" suddenly awakened one day.

Due to the effects of the "Gift" she possesses, she is firmly convinced that she will "die in the not-too-distant future." Furthermore, she does not hide this fact and openly reveals it to those around her.

In order to leave no regrets in her short remaining life, and to fully sing the praises of her fleeting youth, she asks the protagonist out, pleading, "Please be my lover."

Hiding her wounds behind a smile... what will this girl, who is destined to lose everything, find in this place?

Translated from [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/unlessterminalia/character/#inpage-chara]Official Website[/url].
